description: Show the Developer a screenshot or a short screen recording on the dashboard instead of naming a file in chat. It is copied (not moved) next to the plan, stays on this computer and out of git, and appears on the Goal, on the step or on the hand test you name; the Developer clicks it to enlarge. Allowed: .png .jpg .jpeg .webp .gif and .webm .mp4, up to 10 MB, with a short caption. To take one back, pass remove with its ID (such as 'p2') instead.

caption.description: What it shows, in a few plain words (up to 200 characters).

goal.description: The claimed Goal's ID, such as 'ship-oauth-login'. Needed only when this Session holds several Goals.

hand_test.description: The ID of the hand test it is about, such as 'h2'.

path.description: The file's path, absolute or from the project's folder.

remove.description: The ID of a picture to remove (such as 'p2'), instead of attaching one.

task.description: The ID of the Task it is about, such as 't3'.

name: attach_picture
title: Attach picture
